token_grammar: ASCII case-sensitive /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$/ with no normalization, trimming, coercion, numeric interpretation, or ordering
precedence: Strict streaming parsing enforces depth on object/array entry. Each member value is fully parsed before decoded-key duplicate detection; after a valid duplicate is detected, later members are not parsed. Post-parse INVALID_UNICODE follows all lexical, depth, and duplicate checks.

Root validation: ROOT_NOT_OBJECT; unknown root fields before missing root fields; fixed type order profile, comparison_revision, proposals; UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE; comparison revision byte limit then grammar; proposals array then count.

Proposal entries validate in input order: PROPOSAL_NOT_OBJECT; unknown proposal fields before missing proposal fields; fixed type order proposal_id then base_revision; proposal ID byte limit then grammar; base revision byte limit then grammar.
After every proposal is valid, duplicate proposal IDs reject. Only then are exact equality partitions classified.

classification.single_match: exactly one matching proposal and zero nonmatching proposals
classification.multiple_match: at least two matching proposals and zero nonmatching proposals
classification.no_match: zero matching proposals and at least one nonmatching proposal
classification.mixed_match: at least one matching and at least one nonmatching proposal
classification.match_definition: proposal.base_revision === comparison_revision over exact decoded strings only
classification.ordering: input array order never changes output semantics; output IDs sort in ASCII order

nonclaims: No object existence, identity, actual freshness, current-state, authority, authentication, authorization, or policy claim.
No operation payload, digest, apply, acceptance, winner, merge, CRDT, OT, revision advancement, lifecycle, or clock behavior.
No transport, delivery, routing, replay, deduplication, persistence, filesystem, artifact, execution, runtime, provider, credential, spend, integration, publish, deploy, or interoperability behavior.

evidence_requirements.differential: Every frozen raw input must be evaluated independently by JavaScript and Python and equal its frozen exact projection byte-for-byte.
evidence_requirements.fuzz: Generated proposal counts must include 0, 1, 2, 31, and 32 and assert complete independently derived projections for original and permuted inputs.
evidence_requirements.parser_parity: Competing parser failures must include errors within duplicate values, errors after completed duplicates, invalid Unicode, and extreme nesting; both independent parsers must emit the same closed code.
